payload.core_mechanism_summary: Double loop enumerating all open-close run pairs, tracking current open deficit and matching counts via min/max to count regular subsegments in O(n^2).
payload.rationale: The solution explicitly iterates over all even starting indices (opening runs) and for each scans forward through all later runs, which is exhaustive enumeration of subsegment boundaries. It uses direct computation on run lengths to avoid per-bracket simulation, fitting a complete search approach.
